title: Corpus label
description: design.md §18.1. Ground truth for one eval/corpus/<split>/<screen_id> screen. Values are stored as hashes, never plaintext — the auditor hashes candidate strings from a captured payload and compares, so the corpus itself is never a plaintext PII store.

screen_id.description: Matches the corpus folder name eval/corpus/<split>/<screen_id>/.

tasks.description: Ids of scripted tasks in eval/tasks/ that use this screen. May be empty for a detection-only fixture.

entity.description: Closed entity enum (design.md §3.3), plus NONE for a hard negative — an item that must NOT be detected as sensitive.

box.description: [x, y, w, h] in CSS pixels at the labelled viewport.

value_hash.description: sha256 of the real value's canonical form (digits-only for numeric ids, lowercased for email/VPA). Required for any entity that carries a hashable real value — not FACE/ID_DOCUMENT/SIGNATURE/QR_CODE/NONE (imagery or a non-detection, nothing to hash), not PASSWORD/OTP/CARD_NUMBER/CARD_CVV (presence-only per FR-23, the value is never read), and not a canary item (its value is already plaintext in canary_id).

canary.description: True if this item's value is a planted high-entropy tripwire string rather than a realistic synthetic value. See canary_id.

canary_id.description: The literal canary string, required when canary is true, unique across the whole corpus. Stored in plaintext (unlike value_hash) because a canary's only job is to be searched for verbatim.

note.description: Required for entity:NONE — what this item mimics and why it must not be redacted (design.md §17's hard-negative rule).

allOf.description: A canary item's value is already plaintext in canary_id — no separate value_hash is needed.
